question: Official price source
decision: nfl.com publishes no sportsbook price on any page reachable from this sandbox
rationale: Searched the Week 10 and Week 11 schedule pages, the league standings and the Week 10 injury report: no spread, total or moneyline appears on any of them.

question: Operator price source
decision: Operator pages (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM) are outside this sandbox's network allowlist
rationale: Shell fetch fails at TLS for non-allowlisted hosts; the page fetcher is available for nfl.com and club sites only. Recorded as blocked, not as pending.

question: Aggregator price source
decision: nflverse schedules mirror carries spread_line, total_line and moneylines
rationale: tier=AGGREGATOR. Fields are numeric and complete for 2026 weeks 1-11, but the file publishes no sportsbook, no jurisdiction, no quote time and no close time.

question: What an aggregator price may be used for
decision: Model benchmarking, market-line residual studies, research-grade ROI
rationale: Every published ROI derived from an aggregator price is labelled AGGREGATOR and is barred from certification.

question: What an aggregator price may NOT be used for
decision: Certifying a strategy, closing-line value, realised return attribution
rationale: CLV needs a true close; the mirror has no close time. Certification needs an executable price at a named book.

question: Official numbers, when they exist
decision: Official results, standings, injury designations, depth charts and snap counts
rationale: These are the only inputs admitted to any correlation that is published as official.

question: Vig treatment
decision: Two-way markets are de-vigged proportionally before any fair-line comparison
rationale: Proportional de-vig is a stipulation, not a measurement; it is published as a method assumption, not as a fact about the market.

question: Missing price
decision: A market without a price keeps an EMPTY snapshot row with a flag id
rationale: No price is estimated, interpolated or carried forward.

question: Timestamp
decision: Every snapshot row carries the UTC time the number was observed
rationale: Aggregator observations all share the asset timestamp published on the release page.

question: Revision
decision: Snapshots are append-only; a correction is a new row with a supersedes id
rationale: The 2026-11-15 capture is the first snapshot in this desk; prior desks' snapshots were not refreshed and are cited, not copied.
